missionParagraphs: We are veterans of the United States Armed Forces, here in Athens County, Ohio.
Veterans supporting veterans. A place to show up, be heard, and look out for one another — no rank, just respect.
volunteerIntro: Want to lend a hand? Come to a listed gathering, or reach out through Facebook once the page link is added.
donateIntro: A public donation option is not listed here yet. If you’d like to give, please check with the organization directly so funds go to the right place.
addressNote: This is the American Legion Post 21 address used for current public listings. Confirm on the Events page before you visit.
